name: modules-context-external-unreachable
about: modules.context 绑到没有人监听的本机端点（127.0.0.1:9）：server 照常启动；轮次里取 manifest 失败（MODULE_TRANSPORT_UNAVAILABLE），本轮失败，下一轮重新取。比较帧与落盘。
config:
schemaVersion: 1
agent:
  model: bbx/deterministic
  maxContextTokens: 65536
  maxOutputTokens: 8192
model:
  providers:
    bbx:
      protocol: openai
      url: {MOCK}/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      models:
        deterministic:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
telemetry:
  enabled: false
modules:
  context:
    enabled: true
    implementationId: bbx.context
    contract: pilotdeck.context/v1
    transport: module-http-v2
    endpoint: http://127.0.0.1:9
    manifestPath: /cx/module-manifest
    callPath: /cx/call
    methods:
      - prepare_for_model
